title: Тематическая аргументация и сложный синтаксис
description: Обсуждение абстрактных тем со сложной структурой.
contains: противопоставления (while/whereas/although), причинно-следственные (consequently/hence/thus), вводные (As far as I'm concerned), построение развернутого аргумента.
intro:
🗣 Тема: Тематическая аргументация и сложный синтаксис — обсуждение абстрактных тем со сложной структурой.

⏱ Сколько займет: 6-8 дней по 30 минут

🎯 После этой темы ты сможешь: строить развернутый аргумент; использовать while/whereas/although, consequently/hence/thus; связывать сложные предложения в связный текст.

sections.title: 🎯 Зачем эта тема
sections.html:
Это финальный навык C1 — собрать все вместе. На C1 ты не просто высказываешь мнение — ты строишь АРГУМЕНТ: тезис, доводы, контраргумент, вывод. И делаешь это сложными предложениями — с придаточными, противопоставлениями, причинно-следственными связями. Это язык эссе, дебатов и серьезных дискуссий.

Когда это нужно:

  • Противопоставление: Whereas the first approach is cheap, the second is reliable.
  • Следствие: The data was flawed; consequently, the conclusions are suspect.
  • Развернутый аргумент: As far as I'm concerned, the benefits, though real, are outweighed by the risks.

Главное правило: строй аргумент по схеме «тезис → довод → пример → контраргумент → вывод» и связывай части сложным синтаксисом.

Связь с другими темами C1: это кульминация — объединяет discourse markers (13), hedging (12), participle clauses (9), nominalisation (10) и register (16).

sections.title: 📖 Теория
sections.html:
1. Противопоставление: while / whereas / although

СловоФункцияПример
while / whereasпрямой контраст двух идейWhereas A is cheap, B is durable.
although / though / even thoughуступкаAlthough it rained, we went.
despite / in spite ofуступка (+ сущ./ing)Despite the rain, we went.

2. Причинно-следственные связки

  • consequently / hence / thus / therefore / as a result — поэтому.
  • hence и thus часто + сущ./причастие: thus creating confusion / hence the delay.
  • owing to / due to / on account of — из-за (+ сущ.).

3. Вводные для позиции

  • As far as I'm concerned… / From my perspective… / To my mind…
  • It is my contention that… / I would argue that… / There is a strong case for…

4. Структура развернутого аргумента

  1. Тезис: четкое утверждение (I would argue that…).
  2. Довод + пример: This is because… For instance…
  3. Контраргумент: Admittedly, some would claim… However…
  4. Вывод: On balance, therefore…

5. Сложный синтаксис: вложенные придаточные

Соединяй идеи в одно сложное предложение:

  • The policy, which was introduced last year, has, despite initial criticism, proved effective.
  • What makes this argument compelling is that it accounts for both cost and sustainability.

6. Причастные и вводные обороты

  • Having considered both sides, I conclude that…
  • Given the evidence, it seems clear that…
  • Taking everything into account, the argument holds.

7. Равновесие и осторожность

Сильный аргумент признает другую сторону и смягчает (hedging): не X is always bad, а X may well have drawbacks. Крайности слабят аргумент, нюансы усиливают.

💡 Главный секрет C1-эссе: покажи, что ты видишь ОБЕ стороны, но все равно делаешь вывод.

sections.title: 🎙 Как это видит носитель / Где палится русскоязычный
sections.html:
👁 Как это видит носитель

  • Известное — в начало, новое — в конец. Носитель ставит главную, новую информацию в конец предложения (end-focus): What makes this argument compelling is its simplicity. Поэтому так естественны cleft-конструкции и пассив, который переносит новое вправо.
  • Подлежащее и сказуемое держатся рядом. Сложный синтаксис не значит «вставить все в середину»: длинные уточнения носитель уносит в конец или в причастный оборот. The policy proved effective, despite strong initial criticism from industry groups читается легче, чем двадцать слов между policy и proved.
  • Первое предложение абзаца — его тезис. Носитель ожидает topic sentence сразу: Remote work also reduces costs. Привычка начинать абзац с долгой подводки и подходить к мысли постепенно воспринимается как «вода».
  • Пример должен быть конкретным. For example, in many countries… для носителя почти не пример. Убеждает конкретика: In 2019, for instance, Microsoft Japan trialled a four-day week and reported a productivity increase of almost 40%.
  • Связки дозируются. Носитель не начинает каждое предложение с Moreover, Furthermore, Additionally. Логику часто несут структура и отсылки: This approach…, Such a shift…, The result is…. Перегрузка связками звучит механически.

⚠️ Где палится русскоязычный

Калька (как думаем по-русски)ОшибкаКак надо
«По моему мнению, …»According to me, …In my view, … / As I see it, …
«С другой стороны, …»From the other side, …On the other hand, …
«Причина в том, что выросли расходы»The reason is because costs rose.The reason is that costs rose.
«Это не только дешево, но и надежно»Not only it is cheap, but also it is reliable.Not only is it cheap, but it is also reliable.
«Чем больше мы вкладываем, тем больше риск»The more we invest, the more is the risk.The more we invest, the greater the risk.
«Именно поэтому…»Exactly that's why…That is precisely why…
«Рассмотрим это подробнее»Let us consider it more detailed.Let us consider it in more detail.
💡 Самая частая ловушка — According to me и From the other side: две кальки, которые выдают русскоязычного с первой строки эссе. According to вводит только чужой источник (According to the report…), а свою позицию вводят In my view / I would argue that.

sections.title: 🗣 Нарративные приемы носителей / Ошибки именно русскоязычных
sections.html:
🎬 Как носитель чувствует аргументацию и сложный синтаксис

  • Аргумент строится по схеме, а не по вдохновению. Для носителя тезис → довод → пример → контраргумент → вывод — узнаваемый скелет любого хорошего эссе или речи; он слышит, когда звено пропущено.
  • Сильный аргумент признает другую сторону. Для носителя фраза вроде admittedly, some would claim... — не слабость, а признак зрелого мышления; крайности ослабляют, нюансы усиливают.
  • Сложный синтаксис уплотняет мысль в одно предложение. Носитель встраивает вводные и придаточные внутрь главного (which was introduced last year, has, despite criticism, proved effective), чтобы не дробить текст на короткие фразы.
  • whereas/while — для идей, while — также для времени. Для носителя это не взаимозаменяемые слова — контекст мгновенно подсказывает нужное значение.
  • Причинно-следственные связки различаются по весу. Для носителя hence и thus книжнее и суше, чем therefore/as a result — выбор зависит от формальности текста.

⚠️ Ошибки именно русскоязычных

  • while/whereas путают с временным значением. Whereas we waited, it got dark → While we waited, it got dark (whereas — только контраст идей, не время).
  • although + but одновременно. Although it was hard, but we finished → Although it was hard, we finished (один союз).
  • despite + придаточное. Despite it was late → Despite the late hour / Although it was late.
  • Категоричность без контраргумента. X is completely wrong and has no benefits → While X has some merits, the drawbacks outweigh them.
  • Цепочка коротких предложений вместо сложного синтаксиса. The plan was risky. It was expensive. We rejected it → The plan, being both risky and expensive, was rejected.
  • hence с полным предложением вместо существительного. The supplier failed, hence we delayed the launch → The supplier failed; hence the delay или The supplier failed; we therefore delayed the launch (hence естественнее всего с существительным; для целого предложения бери therefore/consequently).
💡 Общий принцип C1: строй аргумент по схеме тезис → довод → пример → контраргумент → вывод и связывай части сложным синтаксисом. while/whereas — для контраста идей (не времени), although + предложение, despite + существительное/ing. Сильный аргумент признает другую сторону.

sections.title: 💡 Примеры с разбором
sections.html:
Противопоставление

  • Whereas traditional methods rely on intuition, data-driven approaches depend on evidence.

Следствие + сложный синтаксис

  • The system, having been poorly designed, failed under load; consequently, the launch was delayed.

Развернутый аргумент

  • As far as I'm concerned, while remote work offers flexibility, it can erode team cohesion; on balance, therefore, a hybrid model seems wisest.

sections.title: ⚠️ Подводные камни
sections.html:
Ошибка 1. while/whereas как «в то время как» во времени (спутали с контрастом)

В аргументации whereas = контраст идей, не время.

❌ Whereas we waited, it got dark.

✅ While we waited, it got dark. (время — только while)

✅ Whereas A is fast, B is safe. (контраст идей)

Ошибка 2. although + but

❌ Although it was hard, but we finished.

✅ Although it was hard, we finished. (один союз)

Ошибка 3. despite + предложение

❌ Despite it was late…

✅ Despite the late hour… / Although it was late…

Ошибка 4. Категоричность без контраргумента

❌ X is completely wrong and has no benefits.

✅ While X has some merits, the drawbacks appear to outweigh them.

Ошибка 5. Цепочка коротких предложений (нет сложного синтаксиса)

❌ The plan was risky. It was expensive. We rejected it.

✅ The plan, being both risky and expensive, was rejected.

exercises.title: Объедини в одно сложное предложение

1. The plan was risky. It was expensive. We rejected it.
  2. The policy was introduced last year. It faced criticism. It worked.
  3. The report was detailed. It was published in May. It changed the debate.

  5. The proposal is ambitious. It is also realistic.
  6. Prices rose. Demand fell. Profits collapsed.
  7. Tom is talented. He lacks discipline.
  8. The city introduced a congestion charge. Traffic fell by 20%.

  10. Anna had lived abroad for years. She understood the cultural nuances.

  12. Remote work saves time. It can isolate employees.
  13. The software was poorly tested. It crashed on launch. The release was delayed.
  14. The evidence is limited. The trend is clear.
  15. Max considered the risks. He invested anyway.

1. Remote work increases flexibility. Admittedly, some argue it weakens team cohesion. On balance, however, a hybrid model captures the benefits while limiting the drawbacks.
  2. Social media connects people across the world. Admittedly, those connections are often shallow. On balance, its value depends on how deliberately it is used.
  3. Free university education widens access. That said, it places a heavy burden on public budgets. All things considered, the long-term social returns appear to justify the cost.
  4. AI can speed up medical diagnosis. Critics would counter that it risks removing human judgement. On balance, it works best as a support tool rather than a replacement.
  5. Electric cars reduce urban pollution. Admittedly, battery production carries its own environmental cost. Taking everything into account, the net effect still favours electrification.
  6. A four-day week improves well-being. Some would claim output inevitably falls. Evidence from trials, however, suggests productivity often holds.
  7. Online exams are cheaper to run. It must be acknowledged that supervision remains difficult. On balance, they suit coursework better than high-stakes finals.
  8. Learning a language young is easier. That said, adults learn grammar far more systematically. All things considered, each age has its own advantage.
  9. Open-plan offices encourage collaboration. Admittedly, they also make concentration harder. On balance, a mixed layout serves most teams better.
  10. Tourism brings money to small towns. Whereas the income is real, so is the strain on housing. On balance, the benefit depends on how growth is managed.
  11. Subtitles help language learners. Some argue they encourage reading rather than listening. On balance, they are most useful at intermediate level.
  12. Public transport is cheaper than driving. Admittedly, it is far less convenient outside cities. Taking everything into account, the comparison depends heavily on where you live.
  13. Working abroad broadens your perspective. That said, it can be isolating in the early months. On balance, the long-term gains outweigh the initial difficulty.
  14. Automation increases productivity. Critics would counter that it displaces workers. On balance, the question is less whether to automate than how to retrain.
  15. Homework reinforces classroom learning. Admittedly, excessive homework erodes motivation. All things considered, quality matters more than quantity.

exercises.title: Исправь ошибки
exercises.html:
1. Although it was hard, but we finished.
  2. Despite it was late, we stayed.
  3. X is completely wrong and has no merit.
  4. The plan was risky. It was costly. We dropped it. (объедини)
  5. Whereas we waited, it got dark. (контраст идей?)
  6. In spite of it rained, we continued.
  7. Even though the cost, the project went ahead.
  8. The data was incomplete, therefore we postponed the decision.
  9. Despite of the risks, we invested.
  10. As far as I concern, the policy is flawed.
  11. Owing to prices rose, sales fell.
  12. While the north is industrial, but the south is rural.
  13. Having reviewing the evidence, we agreed.
  14. On the balance, the reform worked.
  15. Although of the criticism, the law passed.
exercises.answers:
1. ❌ → ✅ Although it was hard, we finished.
  2. ❌ → ✅ Despite the late hour, we stayed.
  3. ❌ → ✅ While X has some merit, the drawbacks outweigh it.
  4. ❌ → ✅ The plan, being risky and costly, was dropped.
  5. ❌ → ✅ While we waited, it got dark. (время → while, не whereas)
  6. ❌ → ✅ Although it rained, we continued. / In spite of the rain, we continued. (in spite of + сущ., не предложение)
  7. ❌ → ✅ Despite the cost, the project went ahead. (even though + предложение, не сущ.)
  8. ❌ → ✅ The data was incomplete; therefore, we postponed the decision. (therefore не соединяет предложения через запятую)
  9. ❌ → ✅ Despite the risks, we invested. (без of)
  10. ❌ → ✅ As far as I'm concerned, the policy is flawed.
  11. ❌ → ✅ Because prices rose, sales fell. / Owing to rising prices, sales fell. (owing to + сущ.)
  12. ❌ → ✅ While the north is industrial, the south is rural. (без but)
  13. ❌ → ✅ Having reviewed the evidence, we agreed.
  14. ❌ → ✅ On balance, the reform worked. (без the)
  15. ❌ → ✅ Despite the criticism, the law passed. (although + предложение)

exercises.html:
«Although the plan was risky, but we approved it. Despite it was costly, it succeeded. Whereas we waited, it got dark. The data was weak, consequently we trusted it. X is totally wrong and has no merit whatsoever. Despite of the delays, the team finished. As far as I concern, the reform was overdue. Owing to the budget was cut, the project stalled. Having reviewing the results, we changed course. On the balance, the benefits are clear. In spite of it was cheap, nobody bought it. The north is rich, whereas but the south is poor. Even though the criticism, the law passed. Due to the system crashed, we lost the data. Given to the evidence, the case is closed.»

(найди 15 ошибок)
exercises.answers:
Исправленный текст:

«Although the plan was risky, we approved it. Despite the cost, it succeeded. While we waited, it got dark. The data was weak; consequently, we did not trust it. While X has some flaws, it is not entirely without merit. Despite the delays, the team finished. As far as I'm concerned, the reform was overdue. Because the budget was cut, the project stalled. Having reviewed the results, we changed course. On balance, the benefits are clear. Although it was cheap, nobody bought it. The north is rich, whereas the south is poor. Despite the criticism, the law passed. Because the system crashed, we lost the data. Given the evidence, the case is closed.»

Ошибки (15):

  1. ❌ Although … but → ✅ Although … (один союз, без but)
  2. ❌ Despite it was costly → ✅ Despite the cost / Although it was costly
  3. ❌ Whereas we waited (время) → ✅ While we waited
  4. ❌ weak, consequently we trusted it → ✅ weak; consequently, we did not trust it (логика + пунктуация)
  5. ❌ totally wrong … no merit whatsoever → ✅ While X has some flaws, it is not entirely without merit (категоричность слабит аргумент)
  6. ❌ Despite of → ✅ Despite / In spite of
  7. ❌ As far as I concern → ✅ As far as I'm concerned
  8. ❌ Owing to the budget was cut → ✅ Because the budget was cut / Owing to budget cuts (owing to + сущ.)
  9. ❌ Having reviewing → ✅ Having reviewed
  10. ❌ On the balance → ✅ On balance
  11. ❌ In spite of it was cheap → ✅ Although it was cheap / In spite of the low price
  12. ❌ whereas but → ✅ whereas (без but)
  13. ❌ Even though the criticism → ✅ Despite the criticism (even though + предложение)
  14. ❌ Due to the system crashed → ✅ Because the system crashed / Due to the system crash
  15. ❌ Given to the evidence → ✅ Given the evidence (без to)

I would argue that its effect depends almost entirely on how consciously we use it. To begin with, tools such as smartphones, having been designed to capture attention, can erode our capacity for deep focus.
